In oracle synthetic experiments, lookahead VoI lowers mean decision loss relative to lowest-confidence-first in all four graph structures (e.g. mixed graphs, budget 2: +0.112 [+0.107, +0.116]). The advantage survives calibration error (ECE 0.10, verifier error 5\%: +0.065 [+0.052, +0.077]), but a loss-blind influence score matches it at budgets of 1--2 and beats it at 3--5, and the advantage disappears once 5\% of dependency edges are wrong.
